item.title: Traffic light is stuck on red for cyclist twice coming from east, 22nd August
item.description:

While waiting on a bicycle, the signal remained red through two complete signal cycles rather than calling a green phase. Please inspect the cyclist detection at this junction, including the relevant sensor/loop and signal configuration, and arrange any necessary repair or adjustment.
